Freemasonry.fact: In 1784, these individuals obtained a Warrant from the Grand Lodge of England (Premiere Grand Lodge) and formed African Lodge, Number 459.

Freemasonry.subject: Courts Cases & Verdicts
Freemasonry.question: When the two _____ grand lodges united in 1813, all U.S.-based Lodges were stricken from their rolls—largely because of the War of 1812
Freemasonry.fact: When the two English grand lodges united in 1813, all U.S.-based Lodges were stricken from their rolls—largely because of the War of 1812. Thus, separated from both English jurisdiction and any concordantly recognised U.S. Grand Lodge, African Lodge retitled itself as the African Lodge, Number 1—and became a de facto Grand Lodge.

Freemasonry.subject: Courts Cases & Verdicts
Freemasonry.question: The name “_____” derives from the rival Antient Grand Lodge of England, established in 1751, whose members called the original Grand Lodge the “Moderns” and themselves the “Antients”
Freemasonry.fact: The French Rite, historically also called the Premier Rite or Modern Rite, is among the oldest surviving codified Masonic rites. The name “Modern” derives from the rival Antient Grand Lodge of England, set up in 1751, whose members called the original Grand Lodge the “Moderns” and themselves the “Antients”.

Freemasonry.subject: Courts Cases & Verdicts
Freemasonry.question: Between 1730 and 1750 the _____ endorsed several significant changes that some Lodges could not endorse
Freemasonry.fact: Between 1730 and 1750 the Grand Lodge endorsed several significant changes that some Lodges could not endorse. A rival Grand Lodge was formed on 17 July 1751, which called itself the "Antient Grand Lodge of England" to signify that, in their opinion, these lodges were maintaining older traditions and rejected changes that the Premiere Grand Lodge had adopted.

Freemasonry.subject: Courts Cases & Verdicts
Freemasonry.question: The _____ of Ireland and the Grand Lodge of Scotland were formed in 1725 and 1736, respectively, although neither persuaded all of the existing lodges in their countries to join for many years
Freemasonry.fact: As an insult, the self proclaimed "Antient Grand Lodge" coined the term "modern" to designate the Premiere Grand Lodge (historians now use Premiere Grand Lodge and Antient Grand Lodge to differentiate the two bodies). These two Grand Lodges vied for supremacy until the Premiere Grand Lodge made a compromise with the antient Grand Lodge to return to a ritual that worked for both Grand Lodges.

Freemasonry.fact: The collector for the port of Pennsylvania, John Moore, wrote of attending lodges there in 1715, two years before the putative formation of the first Grand Lodge in London. Freemasonry.fact: After the full abolition of slavery in 1838, the Lodges were open to all Jamaican men of any race. Jamaican Freemasonry historian Jackie Ranston noted that: Jamaica served as an arms depot for the revolutionary forces when two Kingston Freemasons, Wellwood and Maxwell Hyslop, financed the campaigns of Simón Bolívar, the Liberator, to whom six Latin American Republics owe their independence".

Freemasonry.fact: After 1949, when the new Chinese government (Communist) was established, some lodges moved to Hong Kong or closed due to a lack of new candidates. Freemasonry is currently outlawed by the Chinese Communist Party in mainland China.

Freemasonry.subject: Courts Cases & Verdicts
Freemasonry.question: Meanwhile, the _____ had re-invented Adoption as an all-female lodge in 1901, only to cast it aside again in 1935
Freemasonry.fact: Meanwhile, the French had re-invented Adoption as an all-female lodge in 1901, only to cast it aside again in 1935. In general, Continental Freemasonry is sympathetic to Freemasonry among women, dating from the 1890s when French lodges assisted the emergent co-masonic movement by promoting enough of their members to the 33rd degree of the Ancient and Accepted Scottish Rite to allow them, in 1899, to form their own grand council, recognised by the other Continental Grand Councils of that Rite.

Freemasonry.subject: Courts Cases & Verdicts

Freemasonry.fact: The United Grand Lodge of England issued a statement in 1999 recognising the two women's grand lodges there, The Order of Women Freemasons and The Honourable Fraternity of Ancient Freemasons, to be regular in all but the participants. In 2018 guidance was released by the United Grand Lodge of England stating that, in regard to transgender women, "A Freemason who after initiation ceases to be a man does not cease to be a Freemason".
